priorityList: Use Summon Infernal as your primary long-duration cooldown.
Use Malevolence on cooldown, ideally synced with Summon Infernal if available.
Cast Soul Fire if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards.
Maintain Wither on the target at all times; refresh it when it has less than 5 seconds remaining or before a Chaos Bolt if talented into Internal Combustion.
Cast Chaos Bolt if you have 4 or more Soul Shards, or during Malevolence or Summon Infernal windows.
Cast Infernal Bolt whenever available if you have 3 or fewer Soul Shards.
Cast Cataclysm on cooldown if you are talented into Lake of Fire.
Cast Shadowburn if the target is below 20% health or if the Fiendish Cruelty buff is active.
Cast Conflagrate if you have 4 or fewer Soul Shards and no stacks of Backdraft.
Cast Incinerate if the Chaotic Inferno buff is active and you are not at shard cap.
Use active trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Summon Infernal or Malevolence.
Cast Incinerate as your main filler to generate Soul Shards.
